model_training: experiment-001 train split only; original add-alpha/int8 algorithm unchanged

sentence_selection.rule: deduplicate exact text keeping smallest numeric ID; rank SHA256(seed + NUL + ASCII sentence ID); take smallest ranks before token filtering

tokenization.rule: split on Unicode whitespace, trim outer characters from the fixed set; retain internal punctuation; no model-dependent filtering
tokenization.limitation: oracle token boundaries before wrong-layout conversion; not end-to-end keyboard segmentation

cascade_rules.exactFullThenTwoScore: observed exact hit -> Keep; else alternative exact hit -> Correct; else twoScore
cascade_rules.twoScoreConfirmedByExactFull: observed exact hit -> Keep; else Correct only if twoScore says Correct AND alternative exact hit; otherwise Abstain

wrong_generation: only native-language letter-only tokens of length 1..32; generate after selection and tokenization; retain case
ambiguity: if canonical key belongs to both full dictionaries, any change counts unsafe; report separately, never forced positive
metrics: valid false changes per occurrence and unique type
expected precision at 0.1%,1%,5% synthetic wrong-layout prevalence; not measured deployment precision

challenge.rule: synthetic intent-Keep noise; exclude dictionary hits; also all full-lexicon ambiguous keys with length>=4 and original fixture code/URL/name tokens

hypotheses.H1: compact model adds OOV recovery over exactTrain/Full
hypotheses.H2: exactFullThenTwoScore improves recovery over exactFull without adding unsafe changes
hypotheses.H3: twoScoreConfirmedByExactFull reduces false changes versus exactFull at a coverage cost
hypotheses.H4: twoScore beats singleD on hard negatives at nonzero useful recovery

decision_gate.continuation: report each hypothesis as supported/refuted/inconclusive on this sample; incremental recovery counts only alongside incremental unsafe changes; no threshold tuning on new test; do not claim proof of absence of false corrections

resource_method: front-coded exact blocks vs ngram serialization; fresh inference-only child processes, current RSS/peak/cold startup scoped explicitly; no lexicon/training data retained in probe; warm latency separate
